name: How do plumbers remove roots from sewer lines?

mainEntity.name: How do plumbers remove roots from sewer lines?

acceptedAnswer.text: Plumbers primarily remove roots from sewer lines using hydro-jetting or mechanical augers (drain snakes). Hydro-jetting uses high-pressure water to cut through roots and flush them out, providing a thorough cleaning. Mechanical augers are effective for breaking up smaller root intrusions. The best approach depends on the severity of the root growth and the condition of the pipe. A plumbing professional from CG Plumbing Solutions will assess the situation, often with a camera inspection, to determine the most effective and least invasive method for your specific problem.
acceptedAnswer.description: Plumbers remove roots using hydro-jetting for thorough cleaning or mechanical augers for smaller intrusions, with the method chosen based on severity and pipe condition.
